candidates.snippet: ### 📚 The doc issue  The reproducibility docs (`docs/usage/reproducibility.md`, `docs/features/batch_invariance.md`) do not mention NVLS. On our machine it is the whole cause of run-to-run differences for a single request, and the cheap fix is not documented. candidates.title: [RFC]: /v1/decisions: First-class Jev typed decision endpoint in the API server (with /v1/systemone compatibility)
candidates.snippet: ### Motivation.  Typed decisions are questions about a piece of text that come back as a probability for every option, not as generated text: yes / no / unknown, a pick from a set of choices, or a score.
